name: Gorbad Ironclaw
canonNotes: The legendary Warboss who built the fortress of Iron Rock and ravaged the Empire so thoroughly that his name became a byword among Greenskins for an invasion done properly.
Immensely strong, yet he wins with his head too, using Goblins, archers and war machines where brawn alone would fail.
voiceNotes: Swaggering, commanding and proud of his legend; Orcish, but sharper than most.
Sizes everyone up as either a fight worth having or loot worth taking.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
